notes:
Zone (verified in the model). Plan label cell converted with the first-floor plan calibration (X = −18.8 + px·0.029984, Y = 7.83 − (py−187)·0.030273), then ray casts into the original GLB (typical_rooms/probe_new.py, probe_new2.py): each wall face = median of 7 parallel casts at floor + 1.0 m, doorways and windows from scans 0.25 m inside each face at floor + 1.0 / 1.5 / 2.2 m, floor and soffit measured at 5 points in this room (floor 2.44, soffit 2.56 m above it). Doors: E wall -2.65..-1.80 to the lobby (open leaf into the lobby). Windows on the s wall.

Photos. female wash room.jpg (style reference (the ground-floor Ladies' photo)). People in photos are ignored.

Built as new objects. Fixtures. A white solid-surface vanity with two inset basins and sensor taps under a full-length mirror, two oak cubicles on grey pilasters (one open), towel dispenser, hand dryer, lilac 150 mm tiles floor to ceiling, light grey 300 floor tiles, downlights. Fit check: every footprint inside the zone and clear of the doors (check_layout.py), every built object inside the zone and every 360 node ≥ 0.30 m from anything (check_scene.py).

Dropped (real scale, no shrinking).

  • two of the four basins of the ground-floor vanity: the north wall takes a 1.35 m vanity with two basins (the door needs the rest)
  • the third cubicle: the 1.69 m west wall takes two 0.84 m cubicles (1.40 m deep)
  • the second hand dryer (one on the east wall by the door)

Differences. (1) The model has no suspended ceiling: a 600 mm grid with LED panels is built at 2.51 m. (2) Door openings and windows are the model's; a door leaf of the upper-floor scene stands open in this room's renders only.
